verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-three change resolves the prior major finding. Non-exact-match reactors are now intersected with the repository-owned collaborator roster before the 50-candidate cap, so public sock-puppet reactions cannot displace an ordinary write/maintain/admin collaborator's approval. The exact-match maintainer and App identities remain cap-exempt, roster failures narrow approval to those identities, and every emitted candidate still passes through the existing write+ trust probe. The added unit, YAML-seam, and executed workflow tests exercise the prior crowd-out corpus, a kill control, roster pagination/failure modes, exact-match hoisting, and unauthorized reactions; I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect.
